title: LOOKING FOR A LONG-TERM ARTIST for ASMR RP thumbnails
content: (ENG/TAG OK!) LOOKING FOR A LONG-TERM ARTIST! Hello! I'm an ASMR RP creator on YouTube based overseas, and I'm looking for a reliable long-term artist to work with on a weekly basis for thumbnails and videos! I'm currently working with a limited budget, so I'm hoping to find an artist whose rates are a good fit for ongoing weekly commissions! Looking for: Weekly character art - 1x Simple rendered anime-style bust up or half body art of my OC per week (hopefully to be expanded to full body eventually once my income & budget increases!); Expression variations - Multiple facial expressions on the same art base - PSD file organized into separate layers for eyes/mouth/eyebrows/etc. for ability to mix & match; Occasional additional elements - Small add-ons may be requested (such as a tear overlay, hand caressing the face, etc.). Additional compensation can be discussed. Ideally, each illustration completed within a week of providing the script + directions. Must be over 18, add a flower emoji in reply, commit to weekly delivery. Reply with rates and examples; will DM for further discussion. (New account for anonymity.)

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST.

author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series. Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. We have steady book work planned well beyond this first title: the right illustrator will have ongoing commissions for the foreseeable future. The project: ~640 words, 14 full spreads + cover, 8.5" × 8.5" paperback. Warm, playful, family-centered, told entirely in first-person visuals. Soft, expressive, cinematic storytelling; classic picture-book charm with real emotional range. Need consistent characters/animals/settings across scenes/angles, strong sequential storytelling. Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones. Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test. Future books with paid commissions and royalty opportunity. Timeline: Hire by November 1, 2026; Thumbnails ~December 15; Finished art ~February 1, 2027; Print-ready ~March 1, 2027. To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing same characters across multiple scenes/angles plus sequential pages, about yourself, availability, and confirmation work is original and human-made (no generative AI).
